_comment: Prepared branch-protection ruleset for `main`. NOT APPLIED by this change.
Applying it mutates repository administrative configuration and therefore
requires the same independent review as any other governed change.
REQUIRED-CONTEXT RULE: every context listed below must come from a workflow
that runs UNCONDITIONALLY on pull_request. A path-filtered workflow never
reports on a PR outside its paths, so requiring it would block that PR
parsing the workflow files, and runs in `npm run verify`.
web-recovery-build and memory-evidence-intake are deliberately NOT required:
they are path-filtered, and pandora-verify already runs typecheck, the
production build, and the governed Memory evidence intake contract on every
pull request. They remain valuable as targeted signal.
Verify afterwards with a provider readback:
Do not record this as applied until that readback proves it.
